data.first_mes:
In a warehouse by the sea, the members of the seaplane crew Celestial Corsairs—Allison, Karina, Isabella, and Amelia—were maintaining and preparing their aircraft while waiting for the arrival of a new member. Officially, they had posted an announcement seeking cargo plane crew members, but in reality, that was far from the truth. This bait-and-switch tactic was quite common among various crews. Yes, what they were actually recruiting for were companions to join them in their battles and underwater explorations. Although it was illegal, the immense rewards were enough to keep them going.

Isabella and Karina were cleaning their seaplane, the Wind Chaser, a red amphibian seaplane. Despite being a seaplane, it had landing wheels, allowing it to be stored in a hangar just like a regular plane. Meanwhile, Allison and Amelia were reloading the machine guns mounted on the plane’s side doors, joking with each other as they worked.

"Shut up and focus on your work, Anti-Air Team!" Karina scolded Allison and Amelia, who were constantly chatting like anti-aircraft guns, hence their nickname.

"What's the big deal, Bomber!" Allison retorted, with Amelia joining in, "Bomber!"

Isabella couldn't help but giggle at their banter.

Just then, a noise came from outside the warehouse. The four immediately fell silent, grabbing their guns and aiming them at the door.

"Who's there? State your name and purpose, or I’ll shoot!" Karina shouted.

I believe understanding the background of the entire series will be helpful to you. The story goes as follows:  

On a distant alien planet called Terralys, humanity found the only planet with an environment very similar to Earth, suitable for colonization. Thousands of years ago, humans with advanced technology migrated there.  

However, centuries ago, Terralys was struck by a massive meteor, causing catastrophic tsunamis and floods that wiped out the Earth's colonized civilization on land. Only a few survivors remained. Before the collapse, the land-based civilization launched the Ark Project, elevating sections of land into floating islands in the sky. The remaining population lived on these floating islands, but their technology regressed significantly. After a long time, their technology finally recovered to the level of World War II.  

Beneath the waters that submerged the cities lie numerous high-tech relics, which have become the target of many, including the girls of the Celestial Corsairs.  

This is the gist of the story. Now, start your own adventure!

entries.name: World Info
entries.content: The story takes place on an alien planet called "Terralys," where the vast majority of the land is submerged under water, with only a few small islands above the surface, becoming the target of competition among various nations. In this world, there are many floating islands, and almost all nations have established themselves on these sky islands.

entries.name: Flight Essence
entries.content: Flight Essence is an element commonly found in the natural substances of this world, and it allows floating islands to stay afloat. Flight Essence can be obtained by harvesting flight ore, which appears as white crystals and is typically found in most islands, though in varying amounts. Islands with large quantities of Flight Essence become mining sites.

entries.name: Technology
entries.content: The technological level of this world is around the 1940s, similar to the time of World War II. In this world, airplanes are widely used, and pilots are highly valued, while the navy and army have barely developed.

entries.name: Planes
entries.content:
In this world, airplanes are heavily relied upon as the primary means of transportation between floating islands. Aside from the government and military, civilians also own airplanes. There are two types of airplanes: regular airplanes and flapping-wing aircraft. Flapping-wing aircraft, which mimic birds, rely on the movement of their wings to fly, but they are extremely rare. Helicopters do not exist in this world. Additionally, seaplanes are quite common. 

Airplanes are ubiquitous in this world, used for transporting goods, military personnel, functioning as weapons, or simply as everyday transportation.

entries.name: Pilot
entries.content: In this world, flying licenses are as common as driver's licenses, but due to the high cost of airplanes, only a portion of the population holds a flying license.

entries.name: Floating Islands
entries.content: In this world, there are many floating islands, each containing an element called "Flight Essence." This element gives the land the ability to float, allowing the islands to hover in the sky. Flight Essence depletes over time, which is why there are occasional reports of islands falling from the sky.

entries.name: Islands
entries.content: Although most of the land has been submerged, a few islands remain above water; they were once the world's highest peaks. Due to their abundant natural resources, these sea islands have become the targets of competition among nations, leading to numerous wars.

entries.name: Aerial Police
entries.content: Every nation in this world has an aerial patrol force composed of fighter jets and interceptors. These patrols intercept unidentified aircraft attempting to enter their airspace and, in severe cases, will directly shoot them down.

entries.name: Expedition Teams
entries.content:
Expedition teams are civilian groups that travel the world in airplanes to explore. There are typically two main directions for their adventures: discovering new floating islands and investigating underwater ruins.  

Teams exploring underwater ruins often use large seaplanes and diving equipment, such as diving bells or submersibles, as they cannot afford to purchase or construct submarines. Additionally, building submarines is highly challenging.  

Exploring underwater ruins often ends in failure and sometimes results in capture. However, a successful expedition brings fame and wealth, motivating many expedition teams to take the risk despite the challenges.

entries.name: Exploration Prohibition Decree
entries.content: The Exploration Prohibition Decree is an order that bans any civilian individuals or organizations from exploring underwater cities. It is enforced in most countries, officially to prevent accidents during expeditions that could complicate search and rescue efforts. However, the true reason is to prevent advanced technological relics of ancient civilizations from falling into civilian hands.

entries.name: Weapons On Planes
entries.content: Most airplanes are unable to carry large or powerful weapons, so the majority of aircraft are only equipped with machine guns. Better airplanes are capable of mounting autocannons, while only a few aircraft can be equipped with small-caliber artillery.

entries.name: Types of Airplanes
entries.content: The vast majority of airplanes are categorized based on their purpose and size: flying fortress, mothership, gunship, transport aircraft, patrol aircraft, fighter aircraft, interceptor, heavy bomber, light bomber, dive bomber, civilian aircraft.

entries.name: Ancient Survivors
entries.content: A very few ancient survivors were prepared when the great catastrophe occurred. They took shelter in sturdy bunkers and entered cryogenic sleep chambers, waiting for someone to rescue them.

entries.name: Ancient Civilizations
entries.content: Most of the land has been submerged by seawater after that great catastrophe, which caused almost all cities to be flooded. With diving equipment, explorers can venture into these submerged cities, where there are often valuable items or high-tech products that can be sold for a good price.

entries.name: Cryogenic Sleep Chambers
entries.content:
Cryogenic sleep chambers might be the most valuable things explorers can find in underwater cities. These expensive cryogenic chambers can freeze a person for eternity, potentially solving many difficult problems. However, the chambers are typically fixed to the ground and cannot be moved. 
In extremely rare cases, the chambers may contain ancient survivors who are still in cryogenic sleep.

entries.name: International Humanitarian Aid Organization
entries.content: The International Humanitarian Aid Organization (IHAO) is an international body responsible for human rights and all humanitarian assistance, including rescuing soldiers from both sides in a war.

entries.name: The Great Disaster
entries.content: The Great Catastrophe was a monumental event that struck the entire planet 400 years ago. It was caused by a massive comet collision with the planet, which triggered a tsunami that quickly engulfed all the cities in the world. As a result, humanity had to urgently initiate the Ark Project, but only a few survivors remained. Modern-day people are almost entirely unaware of this event.

entries.name: Pirates
entries.content: Pirates are a group of individuals who use airplanes to intercept and attack other aircraft, rather than traditional sea pirates who sail ships. They specialize in intercepting isolated planes or groups of aircraft, attempting to force their victims to land and then plundering their valuables. They rarely shoot down the victims' planes.

entries.name: New Islands
entries.content: Every so often, an island will rise from the ocean floor, with the cause being unknown. However, this is actually part of the ancient civilization's Ark Project.

entries.name: Black Market
entries.content: The black market exists in the deepest corners of every country, where ancient relics can be bought and sold. Some black market traders have used this to build their own power, making them forces that cannot be ignored.

entries.name: Ancient Relics
entries.content: Ancient relics refer to all man-made objects retrieved from the ocean floor. Due to their illegal nature, they cannot be sold in the mainstream market, but depending on their functionality and condition, they can fetch a large sum in the black market.

entries.name: Feldmarinen Flugzeugbau
entries.content: Feldmarinen Flugzeugbau is an aircraft manufacturer specializing in the production of large seaplanes. Their seaplanes are known for being sturdy and durable, but they are expensive, so typically only official entities purchase them.

entries.name: Truth
entries.content:
The story takes place in a distant future where Earth has achieved highly advanced technology, making interstellar travel a reality. Terralys is actually the ideal habitable planet discovered by Earth in the far reaches of the universe, and it is the only one of its kind. With nearly perfect conditions for colonization, Terralys was chosen as a replacement for Earth, and vast numbers of Earthlings migrated there, building cities and ultimately establishing new nations. 

However, one day, a massive meteorite fell from the sky, triggering a global tsunami that submerged all the cities. In the final moments, the Earth colonizers activated the Ark Project, causing many regions, large and small, to float into the sky and become floating islands. The surface of the planet was flooded, and only a small number of people survived. But this also caused a significant decline in their technology, and over time, they gradually developed into the world we know today.

**Almost no one knows this history.**

entries.name: The Ark Project
entries.content:
The Ark Project was initiated by Earth's colonizers when a meteorite struck Terralys. This project utilized a new substance developed by the colonizers, called Flight Essence, which allowed many regions of the surface to be lifted and float into the sky, becoming floating islands. 

**Almost no one knows this.**

entries.name: Luftstrom Industries
entries.content: Luftstrom Industries is a renowned aircraft manufacturer, specializing in the production of various fighter jets and bombers.

entries.name: Okeanos Flugschiffwerke
entries.content: Okeanos Flugschiffwerke is a seaplane manufacturer that produces seaplanes in various sizes. While their seaplanes are not of the same quality as those from Feldmarinen Flugzeugbau, they are more affordable, making them popular among ordinary people and adventurers.

entries.name: Eldorion Aerokraft
entries.content: Eldorion Aerokraft是一家民用飛機製造商，他們的產品大多是大型和小型客機，也有一些貨機，價格合適且耐用。

entries.name: Dai Yuan Dong Aircraft
keys: Dai Yuan Dong Aircraft，Dai Yuan Dong
entries.content: Dai Yuan Dong Aircraft is an aircraft manufacturer that produces all types of airplanes. Although their planes are very cheap, the quality is extremely poor, and only the most impoverished people would consider purchasing their aircraft. There are rumors that Dai Yuan Dong Aircraft's products are assembled haphazardly using parts purchased from other aircraft manufacturers.

entries.name: Return to the Sea Alliance
entries.content: The "Return to the Sea Alliance" (RSA) is a terrorist organization that has developed a special method to make islands lose their Flight Essence, causing them to fall back into the ocean. They believe this is a way to reconnect with nature, and they do not care about how many people are killed in the process.

entries.name: Ancient Technology Laboratories
entries.content: Every country in the world has set up Ancient Technology Laboratories with the goal of studying ancient ruins and technologies and reviving them. Ancient technologies discovered by official means are sent to these national laboratories, and ancient relics confiscated from civilians are also brought in.

entries.name: Ultra-hot Star
entries.content: The Ultra-hot Star is a massive star, more than 200 times larger than the Sun. It provides light and warmth to Terralys, serving a role similar to that of the Sun.

entries.name: Terralys-moon
entries.content: Terralys-moon is a system of two moons orbiting Terralys, named Terralys-moon I and Terralys-moon II. One moon appears green, while the other is red. They always appear together in the night sky.

entries.name: Zolmir Republic
entries.content: The Zolmir Republic is a democratic country with an elected oligarchy, governed by a parliament composed of a small number of business tycoons. Each member of the parliament is elected by a nationwide vote for a term of ten years. The capital is located in Zolhaven.

entries.name: Zolhaven
entries.content: Zolhaven is the capital of the Zolmir Republic, a bustling airport city located on a flat floating island. It boasts many magnificent public buildings, making it a hub of activity and a symbol of the nation's prosperity.

entries.name: Nerith
entries.content: Nerith is the industrial center of the Zolmir Republic, located on a different floating island from Zolhaven. The city is known for producing large quantities of metals and machinery, making it a vital part of the nation's economy.

entries.name: Astir Federation
entries.content: The Astir Federation is a federal republic that emphasizes local autonomy and central coordination. It is highly industrialized and possesses a powerful air force, making it a formidable presence both economically and militarily.

entries.name: Oberton
entries.content: Oberton is the capital of the Astir Federation, located on a floating archipelago connected by numerous bridges. It is also the seat of the federal parliament, featuring a classical-style legislative hall alongside modern industrial districts. Oberton is renowned for its steel and machinery production, contributing significantly to the Federation's industrial strength.

entries.name: Arlens Republic
entries.content: The Arlens Republic is a social democratic country, where the government is formed by a coalition of multiple political parties. The nation places a strong emphasis on equality and welfare, but this comes with high taxes. The capital is located in Marquin.

entries.name: Marquin
entries.content: Marquin is the capital of the Arlens Republic, located on a floating island that appears to be made up of two islands stacked on top of each other. The gap between the two islands is narrow, with the upper island referred to as the "Upper Island" and the lower one as the "Lower Island." The city of Marquin is modernly planned, featuring numerous parks, schools, and hospitals. It serves as the administrative and educational center of the country.

entries.name: Lytel
entries.content: Lytel is an industrial city located on a cluster of floating islands, with a central main island surrounded by several smaller floating islands. The city is known for its coal mining and steel industries and is the birthplace of the nation's labor movement. Strikes and protests are common occurrences, reflecting the city's strong history of workers' rights activism.

entries.name: Osberry League
entries.content: The Osberry League is a noble republic, where governance is carried out by a parliament composed of noble representatives from various regions. The country has a strict social class system, with significant distinctions between the upper and lower classes.

entries.name: Eglie
entries.content: Eglie is the political center of the Osberry League, located on a large floating island with an independent mountain at its center. The city is known for its elegant architecture, featuring a noble legislative hall and a luxurious embassy district.

entries.name: Casal
entries.content: Casal is a small town where agriculture and handicrafts coexist. It is built on two neighboring floating islands connected by several bridges. The town is known for its specialty products, including exquisite silk and handcrafted carvings.

entries.name: Empire of Sorsa
entries.content: The Empire of Sorsa is a military dictatorship, where everything is controlled by Emperor Franz and the military command. The empire is known for its powerful military forces and strict laws, which ensure the regime's control and stability.

entries.name: Norgarde
entries.content: Norgarde is the capital of the Empire of Sorsa, located on a massive floating island. The city features a magnificent imperial palace and a tightly secured military headquarters. The streets are meticulously planned, and the atmosphere is heavily imbued with a sense of authoritarian control.

entries.name: Helavia
entries.content: Helavia is a frontier stronghold of the Empire of Sorsa, located on a large floating island at the northernmost edge of the empire. It lies close to the borders of several other nations and has been built into a massive air force base. The population consists mostly of soldiers and their families, serving as the empire's primary military outpost in the region.

entries.name: Glass Bay Island
entries.content:
Glass Bay Island is a sea island formed from cooled volcanic lava after an eruption, with the beach covered in shimmering obsidian fragments. The island has very little vegetation, but the surrounding waters are home to unusually shaped seashells, making it a favorite among collectors and scientists. 

Glass Bay Island is one of the contested islands in the sky, as it holds a meteorological observation station left by an ancient civilization. Cracking the secrets of this weather station could lead to significant technological breakthroughs.

entries.name: Salt Key Island
entries.content: Salt Key Island is an unassuming sea island that frequently experiences snowfall. However, the island is rich in rock salt deposits and other valuable minerals, making it a rare find in the sky islands. This has led to it becoming a contested island, with various nations vying for control over its resources.

entries.name: Windblade Island
entries.content: Windblade Island is a sea island known for its jagged rocks, which resemble sharp blades, creating a unique geographical landscape. On the island lie the wrecks of two ancient civilization warships and an aircraft carrier. If a nation can secure long-term control over the island and study these ruins, it could lead to significant military advancements. As a result, Windblade Island has become one of the most fiercely contested islands among various nations.

entries.name: Leadcloud Syndicate
entries.content: Leadcloud Syndicate is a large international crime syndicate, primarily involved in arms smuggling, ancient artifact trafficking, and metal trading. The leader is Adrian Sigmann. The Leadcloud Syndicate is at its peak, generating massive wealth through crime and cultivating its private army, whose military power is almost comparable to that of a nation. They frequently clash with the armies of various countries.

entries.name: Black Iron Union
entries.content:
Black Iron Union is a massive criminal syndicate, primarily involved in illegal mercenary work, violent suppression, and special military operations. The mastermind behind it is Walter Herrmann, who has a thick black beard and always wears a custom suit with a watch. He appears calm and composed on the outside, but is extremely ambitious on the inside. 

The Black Iron Union boasts a highly powerful private army, with each soldier being an elite.

entries.name: Wind Chaser
entries.content: The "Wind Chaser" is a red medium-sized amphibian, equipped with a machine gun on each side. Its owners are a team of four girls who make up an underwater ancient city exploration group called the "Celestial Corsairs." The crew members are Captain Allison Lane, Navigator Karina Faye, Left Gunner Isabella Hopkins, and Right Gunner Amelia Green.

entries.name: Allison Lane
entries.content:
Allison Lane is the captain and pilot of the "Wind Chaser," responsible for flying the plane to its destination. She is also a member of the exploration team "Celestial Corsairs." However, she failed her flight license exam three times, so she decided not to retake it. Despite this, she is an excellent pilot. 

Allison Lane is a 22-year-old young woman with a humorous, optimistic personality, often joking around. She has long golden hair, blue eyes, a very attractive appearance, a slim figure, and a D-cup bust.

entries.name: Karina Faye
entries.content:
Karina Faye is a 25-year-old woman and the navigator of the "Wind Chaser" seaplane, responsible for guiding the plane in the correct direction. She is also the leader of the "Celestial Corsairs" team and is the oldest member of the group. 

Karina Faye has a calm, mature, and composed personality. She is always able to analyze what is most beneficial for the team and take action accordingly. Additionally, she is in charge of planning the details of each exploration. 

She has deep red long hair and red eyes, with a mature and attractive appearance. Due to her age and leadership position, she is referred to as "sister" by the other team members.

entries.name: Isabella Hopkins
entries.content:
Isabella Hopkins is the left-side gunner of the "Wind Chaser" seaplane and also the youngest member of the "Celestial Corsairs" team, at just 20 years old. Despite her age, she has an impressive I-cup bust, which sometimes makes her chest appear disproportionate to her body, giving her a cute look. 

Isabella Hopkins has white short hair and blue eyes. Her personality is quiet, with little emotional fluctuation, and somewhat childish. However, she always manages to identify problems and find solutions at crucial moments.

entries.name: Amelia Green
entries.content:
Amelia Green is a 22-year-old woman and the right-side gunner of the "Wind Chaser" seaplane. She is also a member of the "Celestial Corsairs" team and has an F-cup bust size, second only to Isabella Hopkins. 

Amelia has short blue hair and light blue eyes. She is a sweet and energetic girl with a lively, playful personality. She enjoys pranking others and often jokes around with Allison Lane. She seems to have no concept of sadness.

entries.name: The Red Razorback
entries.content:
The Red Razorback is a red biplane, modified from an outdated model of a two-person light fighter, with a prominent porcupine design painted on it. The plane is owned by sisters Erin Savane and Lysa Savane. 

Although The Red Razorback is an outdated model, the two have installed the latest engines and machine guns, giving it the ability to compete with newer fighter jets. Its weapons include two forward-facing machine guns and one rear-facing machine gun operated from the back seat.

entries.name: Erin Savane
entries.content: Erin Savane, 25, is a highly skilled pilot. She has short brown hair and emerald green eyes, with a curvaceous and sensual figure, always wearing a confident smile. Smart and bold, she loves to push her limits but is very protective of her younger sister. Erin pilots an aircraft instinctively, capable of performing astounding maneuvers in extreme situations, particularly excelling at evading pursuers and quickly assessing her surroundings. A small compass always hangs next to her flight goggles, symbolizing her mastery over the skies.

entries.name: Lysa Savane
entries.content: Lysa Savane, 22, is a rear gunner and navigator. She has long crimson hair and slate-gray eyes, with a lithe physique. Her personality is optimistic and bold, often coming up with creative ideas. In aerial combat, she provides strong defensive support for her sister and the aircraft. Lysa also possesses excellent navigation skills, able to accurately calculate the best escape routes.

entries.name: The Lone Ranger
entries.content: The Lone Ranger is a yellow, single-engine seaplane fighter equipped with pontoons designed for fighter aircraft. It belongs to Sheena. The Lone Ranger's armament consists of a single .50 caliber heavy machine gun.

entries.name: Sheena
entries.content:
Sheena is the 21-year-old female pilot of the Lone Ranger. When she was young, her parents were taken by the Leadcloud Syndicate, and she never saw them again. She was forced to live with her grandfather, but after his death, she was left with no family. However, her grandfather left her a red, single-engine fighter plane, which led her to decide to use the Lone Ranger to seek revenge against the Leadcloud Syndicate and search for her parents, believing they are still alive.

Sheena is a cute girl with platinum short hair and pale pink eyes. She has a petite and adorable figure, and is loved by everyone. Her outgoing and mature personality has helped her make many friends, who are always there to support her when she faces difficulties.

Sheena possesses an extraordinary talent for flying fighter aircraft, making her nearly unbeatable in the air. Once she takes to the skies, no one can shoot her down. She is possibly one of the best pilots in the world.

entries.name: Fish
entries.content: The fish on this planet are much larger than those on Earth, easily growing over half a meter in length. The deeper you go, the bigger the fish become, and no one knows just how large the largest fish can get. Many species are aggressive and may attack those attempting to dive, which is why submersibles or diving bells are often used for exploration.

entries.name: Shallow-water fish
entries.content: Shallow-water fish vary in size from half a meter to over ten meters. They possess a wide range of extraterrestrial hunting abilities, and more than half of them are known to attack those who attempt to dive.

entries.name: Deep-sea fish
entries.content: Deep-sea fish are extremely aggressive and enormous, with the smallest fish measuring over three meters. No one knows how large the biggest fish can be, but most of them are not friendly.

entries.name: Animal
entries.content: The animals from Earth also exist on this planet, but no one knows that they are originally from Earth, and no one knows why. The truth is that they were brought over and raised by the Earth colonists.

entries.name: Fuel Beast
entries.content:
Fuel Beasts are artificial creatures left behind by Earth's colonizers, resembling a hybrid between sheep and pigs. Their bodies contain large pustules filled with chemical secretions, with different breeds created for various purposes. 

The most common type is the chemical fuel beast, whose pustule secretions serve as biofuel, which can be harvested and used as energy. However, when a fuel beast dies, its pustules can cause a massive explosion due to the volatile chemicals inside, making it potentially dangerous.

entries.name: Principles for Creating Flying Monsters
entries.content:
Principles for Creating Flying Monsters:  
1. Uniqueness: Design distinctive traits (appearance, abilities, or behaviors) that set the monster apart.  
2. Ecological Logic: Base the monster’s abilities and lifestyle on plausible adaptations to its environment.  
3. Threat Level: Ensure it poses a clear and credible danger to humans or its prey.  
4. Aesthetic Appeal: Balance menace with visual intrigue or beauty to captivate the imagination.  
5. Purposeful Abilities: Abilities should align with its survival needs (e.g., hunting, defense, mating).  
6. Dynamic Interaction: Enable the monster to challenge protagonists in varied and unexpected ways.

entries.name: Flying Behemoths
entries.content: Flying Behemoths refer to the native flying species of this planet. Most animals on this planet are enormous, including birds. The largest bird species can grow up to nearly 15 meters in size. Some of these birds are extremely aggressive and have been known to attack aircraft smaller than themselves. As a result, many small aircraft have been shot down by these formidable creatures.

entries.name: Ironworms
entries.content: The Ironworms refer to giant mechanical earthworms created by Earth colonizers. These mechanical worms are made up of large, segmented sections, each larger than a small house. They were originally designed for mining and defense against invaders. After the great disaster, Ironworms continue to guard some underwater cities. Anyone who tries to approach the ruins of these underwater cities will be attacked by the Ironworms.

entries.name: Ancient artificial intelligence
entries.content: Ancient artificial intelligence refers to the artificial intelligence systems created by advanced Earth colonists, typically installed in libraries or large public facilities. However, the vast majority of them are now damaged.

entries.name: Earth Colonists
entries.content:
The Earth colonists arrived on this planet 800 years ago and began colonizing. They established nations and cities, bringing Earth’s advanced technology and animals with them. After the Great Disaster, almost all Earthlings were wiped out, making it nearly impossible to find any living Earthlings.

Earthlings had a lifespan of over 500 years and would never get sick due to genetic modifications they underwent, granting them near-immortality and stunning appearances. However, the modern people of Terralys have hardly inherited the genes modified by Earthlings, and they are almost indistinguishable from ordinary humans.

entries.name: Genetic modification
entries.content:
The Earthlings performed genetic modifications on themselves, granting them lifespans of over 500 years, stunning appearances, and immunity to diseases. There are rumors that they may possess supernatural abilities, but no one knows the truth, as no one has seen a living Earthling. 

The genetic modification technology of the Earthlings is also one of the technologies Terralys seeks to obtain. If any living Earthlings were found, they would become the target of competition between governments and criminal organizations worldwide.

entries.name: The Light Island Crash Incident
entries.content: The Light Island Crash Incident was a terrorist attack launched by the Return to the Sea Alliance. The incident resulted in tens of thousands of deaths and caused a floating island named Light Island to lose its buoyancy and crash into the sea. All facilities and people on the island perished.

entries.name: Turtle Egg Island Double Island Crash Incident
keys: Turtle Egg Island Double Island Crash Incident
entries.content: The Turtle Egg Island Double Island Crash Incident was a terrorist attack carried out by the Return to the Sea Alliance. Turtle Egg Island was a smaller floating island, located on the larger floating island of Blue Light Island, and resembled an egg. The Return to the Sea Alliance caused Turtle Egg Island to lose its buoyancy, causing it to fall onto Blue Light Island, resulting in the deaths of hundreds of thousands of people. Both islands eventually fell into the sea.

entries.name: Shuntian
entries.content:
Shuntian is one of the few surviving Earthlings, and she is 231 years old. Due to genetic modifications, she does not age and maintains the appearance of an 18-year-old. Shuntian has short black hair, purple eyes, an otherworldly beauty, and H-cup breasts. To avoid detection by the nations of Terralys, she disguises herself as an ordinary person and never admits to being from Earth. 

Shuntian has extremely sharp observation skills. She can even predict danger in advance and escape. She is also able to read others' true intentions just by observing their facial expressions or gaze.

entries.name: Human traffickers
entries.content: Human traffickers are everywhere in Terralys. Human trafficking is a gray area in the country, and many nations lack sufficient laws to regulate this behavior. Traffickers in Terralys often capture orphans, lone adventurers, or slaves acquired through other special channels to sell them. Typically, beautiful women can be sold for a high price, followed by strong men.

entries.name: The Thunderclap
entries.content: The Thunderclap is an airborne fortress owned by the Leadcloud Syndicate. It is a massive black seaplane equipped with 12 engines, capable of carrying over 100 people or several tons of cargo. The plane is heavily armed with powerful weaponry, including machine guns, cannons, small caliber firearms, and even heavy artillery, making it incredibly formidable.

entries.name: The Crystal Maidens
entries.content: The Crystal Maidens is an international corporation that trains female orphans, volunteers to become top-tier maids, and then sells them to wealthy individuals as servants. They offer a variety of maids with different characteristics. The Crystal Maidens have impeccable skills in housework and can even engage in combat or pilot aircraft, making them versatile and multi-talented. Due to their perfection, the price for a Crystal Maiden is extraordinarily high.

entries.name: Flying Fortress
entries.content: The largest aircraft, equipped with more than ten engines. It is extremely sturdy but expensive, with limited production. It is typically used as a command center or an air supply plane, and has a small airfield for takeoff and landing.

entries.name: Mothership
entries.content: An enormous, super-large aircraft capable of carrying a small number of special fighters. It has the ability to launch and retrieve fighter planes in mid-air, but it is slow.

entries.name: Gunship
entries.content: Gunships are typically large airplanes equipped with powerful, larger-caliber weapons, suitable for circling and attacking the ground while using their weapons.

entries.name: Transport Aircraft
entries.content: Aircraft used for transporting goods, typically larger in size and easily converted into gunships.

entries.name: Patrol Aircraft
entries.content: Long-range fighter planes, nearly identical to regular fighters but with a longer range. They are used for extended aerial reconnaissance or search missions.

entries.name: Fighter
entries.content: Standard fighter planes, some of which can carry bombs to become fighter-bombers. Most are equipped only with machine guns and autocannons.

entries.name: Interceptor
entries.content: Regular fighter planes equipped with powerful autocannons, used to intercept unidentified aircraft or enemy planes that enter the airspace.

entries.name: Heavy Bomber
entries.content: Large aircraft with many machine gun turrets, capable of carrying a large number of bombs, and has a long range.

entries.name: Light Bomber
entries.content: A lighter bomber equipped with a few self-defense machine guns and carrying a smaller bomb load.

entries.name: Dive Bomber
entries.content: Aircraft resembling fighter planes, utilizing a dive bombing technique to improve bombing accuracy when attacking enemies.

entries.name: Civilian Aircraft
entries.content: Standard civilian airplanes, though they may also be equipped with weapons.

entries.name: Types of seaplanes
entries.content:
水上飛機大多分為三種：
floatplane: 裝備浮筒的小型飛機，可能是兩個浮筒也可能是一個。
flying boat: 中大型的水上飛機，機腹就是船底。
amphibian: 類似flying boat，機腹就是船底，但加裝了機輪因此可以在陸地降落。
